description: Read-only contract call on Avalanche (eth_call) at the latest block, without a transaction or gas: send ABI-encoded calldata, or a function signature such as balanceOf(address) with args and the call is encoded and its result decoded for you. Use to read any view function that has no dedicated tool (the example reads USDC totalSupply). Calldata up to 8 KB; a call that reverts is 422 with the reason, uncharged. Example: to=0xB97EF9Ef8734C71904D8002F8b6Bc66Dd9c48a6E, data=0x18160ddd. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

args.description: Arguments for a function signature in data: comma separated, or a JSON array for arrays and tuples

data.description: 0x ABI-encoded calldata (4-byte selector plus arguments), or a function signature: totalSupply(), balanceOf(address), or with its result types, balanceOf(address) returns (uint256)

from.description: Optional 0x sender address for calls that check msg.sender

returns.description: Result types to decode when data is a signature without them, for example uint256 or address,uint8

name: avax_call
title: Eth call, Avalanche
